reviewSamples.author: Allison Shevlin
reviewSamples.text: Carlos and his team are TOP NOTCH. We had a few companies come out to do our due diligence before going with a company. My husband and I were very impressed with the communication, transparency, and cost of our project.

reviewSamples.author: Marie Belony
reviewSamples.text: Great company to work with from start to finish! Carlos was wonderful to work with. He is knowledgeable, responsive, and made sure everything was handled properly from beginning to end. The crew did a great job and left everything clean.

reviewSamples.author: Lou Buttari
reviewSamples.text: I rarely if ever fill out reviews on line but felt that I had to share my experience this time. I am so glad I chose Luna and Sons to do my reroof. They were so professional and the quality of the work was top notch!
